title: Action Words
introduction: Learn about action words through simple examples and practice.
definition: Action words tell us what someone or something does.
rules: Act out the words as you say them.

vocabulary.description: Push yourself up from the ground.

examples.question: Complete: I ___ water (drink or jump).
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.

exercises.question: Complete: I ___ a book (read or swim).
Complete: I ___ a song (sing or sit).

summary: Action words tell us what someone or something does.
